record.notes: compute/manus-cloud-computer already records Manus Cloud Computer as paid-only at USD 30 a month for 2 vCPU, 4 GB and 70 GB. That record is about the persistent server, not the agent, and it would read as 'Manus has no free tier' unless this finding sits beside it. Merge into a single Manus record, not a second provider row. The unit here is a credit and the vendor publishes no credit-to-minute rate, so 1,500 monthly credits cannot be converted to hours. A one-time 1,000 credits are granted at signup, separate from the daily refresh. The 1,500 monthly cap is the number the marketing does not show.
